Question: Why doesn't VoLTE/HD Voice work on my phone?

Answer: VoLTE requires a VoLTE-enabled handset, a compatible SIM, and the VoLTE/4G Calling setting enabled in device settings. Some imported or older devices may not support VoLTE on Indian bands even if they support 4G data.

Topic: Device Compatibility
title: Why doesn't VoLTE/HD Voice work on my phone?
